description: List an API, MCP server, model endpoint or A2A agent on one of your own StartupHub profiles, so people and agents can find, try and pay for it. Check first with preview: true (nothing saved). kind: openapi (spec URL), mcp (server URL), chat (OpenAI-compatible base URL), agent (site or agent card URL), app (site, link only). Optional price_per_call in USD (free if omitted), provider_key to sell calls through StartupHub (stored encrypted; you earn the price less 20%). Returns the listing id. Never creates an account: the key must belong to the profile owner. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

preview.description: Only read what the URL offers, save nothing

startup_id.description: Your profile id (my_apis returns the profiles you can list on)

startup_slug.description: Or your profile slug, e.g. acme-ai from startuphub.ai/startups/acme-ai

name: list_my_api
title: list my api
